CONFIG_CONFLICT.zh: {subject, select, skill {Skill 已被修改，请刷新后重试} manifestExists {另一份 Skill 清单已存在，未覆盖任何文件} other {配置已被修改，请重新载入后再编辑}}
CONFIG_CONFLICT.en: {subject, select, skill {The skill has changed; reload it and try again} manifestExists {The other skill manifest already exists; no file was overwritten} other {The configuration has changed; reload it before editing}}

CONFIG_NOT_DIRECTORY.zh: Skill 设置的父路径不是目录。
CONFIG_NOT_DIRECTORY.en: A parent of the skill settings file is not a directory.

CONFIG_NOT_FILE.zh: 配置文件不是普通文件。
CONFIG_NOT_FILE.en: The configuration file is not a regular file.

CONFIG_SYMLINK_UNSUPPORTED.zh: 配置文件路径包含符号链接，不能安全读写。
CONFIG_SYMLINK_UNSUPPORTED.en: The configuration file path contains a symbolic link and cannot be read or written safely.

EXTENSION_ACTION_BUSY.zh: 此配置已有管理操作正在执行
EXTENSION_ACTION_BUSY.en: Another management action is running on this configuration

EXTENSION_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED.zh: {subject, select, agent {该 Agent 不支持此原生操作} resource {该资源不支持此原生操作} reason {{reason}} unverified {无法验证原生管理命令参数} skill {此 Skill 不支持该操作} skillSettings {当前 Agent 没有此原生 Skill 设置适配。} other {此 CLI 未声明该操作}}
EXTENSION_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED.en: {subject, select, agent {This agent does not support this native action} resource {This resource does not support this native action} reason {{reason}} unverified {The native management command's options could not be verified} skill {This skill does not support this action} skillSettings {This agent has no native skill settings adapter.} other {This CLI does not declare this action}}

EXTENSION_NATIVE_EDITOR_REQUIRED.zh: 此文件的凭据格式无法在此编辑，请使用外部编辑器。
EXTENSION_NATIVE_EDITOR_REQUIRED.en: Credentials in this file cannot be edited here; use an external editor.

EXTENSION_NOT_FOUND.zh: {subject, select, skill {Skill 不在当前配置中} other {扩展不存在}}
EXTENSION_NOT_FOUND.en: {subject, select, skill {The skill is not in the current configuration} other {The extension does not exist}}

EXTENSION_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED.zh: Droid 不支持自定义配置目录，请清除此设置后再管理扩展。
EXTENSION_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED.en: Droid does not support a custom configuration directory; clear this setting before managing extensions.

EXTENSION_READ_ONLY.zh: {subject, select, reason {{reason}} managed {请通过所属插件或受管配置管理此扩展} plugin {请通过所属插件管理此 Skill} action {此 Skill 不支持该操作} skill {此 Skill 为只读} other {此扩展文件为只读}}
EXTENSION_READ_ONLY.en: {subject, select, reason {{reason}} managed {Manage this extension through its plugin or managed configuration} plugin {Manage this skill through its plugin} action {This skill does not support this action} skill {This skill is read-only} other {This extension document is read-only}}

EXTENSION_SCOPE_MISMATCH.zh: {subject, select, skill {操作范围与 Skill 来源不一致} other {操作范围与扩展来源不一致}}
EXTENSION_SCOPE_MISMATCH.en: {subject, select, skill {The scope does not match where the skill comes from} other {The scope does not match where the extension comes from}}

EXTENSION_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED.zh: {subject, select, skill {请先选择项目，再管理项目的 Skill。} skillSettings {未找到所选范围的 Skill 设置。} dsh {DSH 插件随连接配置安装，不能按项目安装。} other {当前 CLI 不支持按项目管理扩展。}}
EXTENSION_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED.en: {subject, select, skill {A project-level skill action needs a valid project.} skillSettings {No native settings were found for the chosen scope.} dsh {DSH plugins belong to a backend profile and cannot be installed per project.} other {This CLI has no project-level option, and the action will not fall back to user level.}}

INVALID_EXTENSION_HASH.zh: 请先读取 Skill 当前内容后再操作
INVALID_EXTENSION_HASH.en: Read the skill's current content before managing it

INVALID_EXTENSION_SCOPE.zh: 项目级操作需要选择项目
INVALID_EXTENSION_SCOPE.en: Choose a project for a project-level action

INVALID_EXTENSION_TARGET.zh: {subject, select, mcp {请从当前运行时选择 MCP 服务器} create {请选择创建位置} dsh {使用 DSH npm bundle 名称，可带固定版本} other {使用插件原生标识，例如 name@marketplace；不能传入路径、命令或选项。}}
INVALID_EXTENSION_TARGET.en: {subject, select, mcp {Choose an MCP server from the current runtime} create {Choose where to create it} dsh {Use a DSH npm bundle name, optionally with a fixed version} other {Use the plugin's native identifier, such as name@marketplace; paths, commands and options are not accepted.}}

INVALID_SKILL_SETTINGS.zh: 无法安全读取全部原生设置；未修改任何配置。
INVALID_SKILL_SETTINGS.en: Not every native setting could be read safely; no configuration was changed.

SKILL_METADATA_UNSUPPORTED.zh: 无法安全读取 Skill 元数据。
SKILL_METADATA_UNSUPPORTED.en: The skill metadata could not be read safely.

SKILL_SETTING_OVERRIDDEN.zh: 更高优先级的项目设置覆盖了此选择，请在对应设置中修改；未修改配置。
SKILL_SETTING_OVERRIDDEN.en: A higher-priority project setting overrides this choice; change it there. No configuration was changed.

SKILL_STILL_DISABLED.zh: 其他作用域的 disabledSkills 或 SKILL.md 的 enabled: false 仍在禁用此技能，请在来源处恢复；未修改配置。
SKILL_STILL_DISABLED.en: disabledSkills in another scope, or enabled: false in SKILL.md, still disables this skill; re-enable it there. No configuration was changed.
